FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND c.active = TRUE
GROUP BY o.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 20;
